notes.title: Demo Update 0.23
notes.content:
- Added the option to rest for 5 minutes
- Updatied merchants' goods and amount of money
- Slight acceleration of the combat process
- Reduced the cost of using the kitchen to 100 rubles
- New items and recipes
- Added the option of extracting wood with a machete
- Added numerical value of skill and stat progress on the character screen
- Combat mechanics with no limit on the number of attacks
- Added the probability of finding shell casings on the ground after a gun battle
- Reduced animation time of some actions
- Updated game interface and notifications

Old saves will not work, you need to start a new game

notes.title: In-game events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/49f7b2cf76e3c6879bfd33c883ec6580de1fa398.jpg[/img]

[h3]During the course of the game, an event may start that changes the conditions of the game or makes it more difficult.[/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]Solar flare[/h3] Exposure to radiation throughout the location except for safe or underground structures. 

[*][h3]Toxic precipitation[/h3] If it starts raining during the event, a player with insufficient protection against toxins will start getting poisoned.

[*] [h3]Eclipse[/h3] Reduced natural light and consequently more difficult searches.

[*] [h3]Aggressive animals[/h3] Increased chance of animal attacks, in places where they may be.

[*] [h3]Gang activity[/h3] Increased chance of ambush or encounter with raiders.

[*] [h3]Cold snap[/h3] A sudden drop in temperature. Warm clothes or warming up by the fire will help prevent frostbite.
[/list]
[h3]The duration and power of an event can have different meanings.[/h3]

notes.title: Crafting and cooking
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/8ba920bbbed660336d3dafc3927e4e3872465b85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/991293a1ed6d3bbb7a56ad00609550c0c3b0e3af.png[/img]

[h3]A few crafting and cooking recipes.[/h3]
[list]
[*] [h3] Water. [/h3] Water must be boiled at the campfire/kitchen before use.
[*][h3] Food.[/h3] Cooked food gives more bonuses, but takes time and effort.
[*] [h3] Dismantling.[/h3] Some items can be disassembled into components.
[/list]
